title: Lead AI Architect
description:
Lead AI Architect

London (Hybrid) | £120,000 - £170,000


This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced AI and Data Architect looking to shape enterprise-wide standards, frameworks, and best practices across a growing legal environment. You'll combine high-level strategy ownership with hands-on architectural leadership across modern AI and data platforms.


The Company

This organisation is a legal services company expanding their AI remit. They work across a range of transformation programmes, designing scalable, future-proof solutions. With continued investment in AI capabilities, they are expanding their architecture leadership team to drive innovation and technical excellence.


The Role

  • Define and own the organisation's AI and Data Architecture strategy, standards, patterns, and governance frameworks
  • Lead architectural design across modern data platforms, machine learning solutions, and generative AI initiatives
  • Establish best practice for MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, and AI governance
  • Design solutions involving agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, model routing, AI gateways, and model management
  • Manage and mentor two direct reports while providing technical leadership across client and internal programmes

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong background as a Data Architect with recent experience leading AI architecture initiatives
  • Proven experience developing and owning enterprise data and AI strategy
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks and modern cloud-based data platforms
  • Experience establishing architecture standards, governance models, and delivery best practices
  • Professional services or consultancy experience with strong stakeholder management

If this looks like it could be a good fit, please apply below!
